children: The Russian federal government recorded a budget deficit of RUB 5.8 trillion in January-August 2026, or 2.5% of the GDP, much larger than RUB 3.9 trillion in the same period a year ago, according to preliminary estimates.
Federal expenditures climbed by 14.7% year-on-year to RUB 31.724 trillion, while revenues rose by 9.2% to RUB 25.929 trillion.

title: Russia Government Budget Widens in January-August
